name: Streaming Interpretation Of Contracts And Smart Contracts Smart Interpretation Or Interpre 238C8161Ff
text: Interpretation of Contracts and Smart Contracts distinguishes deterministic computer language, in which one meaning and result are contemplated, from natural language, which remains open to multiple meanings. This independently supports the language-logic mechanism in Kaal's claim about smart-contract interpretation. The proposition does not by itself establish that smart contracts cannot accommodate human business interaction in every setting.
